card: Answer cues: the ward word before the contact, graded by the kernel's own rule
guards: case 7 (purity: stateHash unchanged over 300 timing-bot ticks, twin hash equal) is green by construction once the module exists; replay goldens and VR vectors untouched (no core file changed)
deviations_from_card: Read the kernel's contactVerdict (inArc, guard, ageTicks, windowTicks) per the critic instead of raw facts; ageTicks carried to the impact tick, `perfect` left to gradeContact's default rule (a threat does not carry suppressPerfect). Case 9 added: exchange window -> answer 'window', Air Form (formUntil past impact, not unblockable) -> 'evaded' (the evade is an RNG draw at contact, so the cue stands down rather than read the dice), both no word and no RAISE. Cues gated by ArenaSession.kind through the arena-session seam (training/roster/lab on; tiro, season, practice off - note the card's default leaves the Proving Ground (kind 'tiro') off too). No raiseLeadTicks key (case 3's formula is exact; a lead would make the raise late). Two feat commits instead of test+feat: a test-only commit would be red (module absent); red run recorded with the module moved aside (suite failed to load, 9/9 red). Dimming covers the art sigils (sigil-player.ts draw with opacity, warning mark dropped) of telegraphs and pending casts; the procedural fallback telegraphs and school-effect shapes are not dimmed (sigil-player.ts is outside the write set). Cue word is a dedicated BitmapText in CombatFeedback, not a pooled number.
notes: Cases 1, 2 and 4 step the bout to contact and assert the real ledger's post-hoc grade equals the cue's prediction. hitBearing filter mirrored from ledger.ts (private there). snapshot().feedback gains cues[] and cueWord for the harness. Full gate 798 vitest green (includes siblings' in-flight tests).
